caption: The drawing depicts a circular object resembling a shallow bowl or plate, viewed from above, placed on a plain off-white background. The bowl is colored in shades of yellow and ochre, with a slightly uneven rim that has a textured, beaded edge. Inside the bowl, there are five reddish-brown leaf-like shapes arranged in an asymmetric composition: three clustered toward the lower half, and two slightly separated toward the upper half, one large and one small. The bowl's interior surface has subtle variations in color, with some lighter and darker areas, and appears to have a matte finish. On the lower right area outside the bowl, the name “E. H. Shellady” and the year “’86” are written in red-brown script. There is no additional ornamentation or background detail.
title: Pa. German Pie Dish
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
